financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Private placement of units (pre-funded warrant + Series E warrant) to an institutional investor; gross proceeds used because net not given
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Offering closed on May 19, 2022. The aggregate gross proceeds to the Company of the Offering were approximately $8.0 million.

warrants.quote: Each Series E Warrant has an exercise price of $0.63 per share of common stock (the “Exercise Price”), is immediately exercisable, will expire five and one-half years from the date of issuance
Each Unregistered Pre-Funded Warrant has an exercise price of $0.0001 per share of common stock, is immediately exercisable, may be exercised at any time until exercised in full
